business_summary: Great Wall Motor Company Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, and automotive parts and components in the People's Republic of China, Europe, ASEAN countries, Latin America, the Middle East, Australia, South Africa, and internationally. The company offers SUVs, sedans, pick-up trucks, multi-purpose vehicles (MPVs), motorcycles, heavy-duty trucks, and energy vehicles primarily under the Haval, TANK, WEY, ORA, GWM Pick-up, GWM SOUO, and GWM brand names. It also provides investment and financing, logistics and goods transportation, buildings rental, after-sales, customer sales, technical development and consulting, technical, and finance leasing services; consulting services on automotive research and development; and operates investment platform. In addition, the company repairs automobiles; transports general goods; researches, develops, and manufactures auto moulds; researches and manufactures motorcycles and related parts; offers technology services, as well as automotive technology research and development, and technical consultancy services; and processes, recycles, and sells waste and used materials. Further, it engages in the wholesale and retail of car accessories; research and test development of engineering technology; trading and brokerage activities; scrap car recycling and dismantling activities; provision of insurance brokerage, technical, and computer system services; and development of network and information security software. The company was formerly known as Baoding Great Wall Motor Company Limited and changed its name to Great Wall Motor Company Limited in May 2003. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Baoding, China. Great Wall Motor Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Baoding Innovation Great Wall Asset Management Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: Great Wall Motor Company Limited는 중화인민공화국, 유럽, ASEAN 국가, 라틴 아메리카, 중동, 호주, 남아프리카 및 국제적으로 자동차, 자동차 부품 및 부품의 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 주로 Haval, TANK, WEY, ORA, GWM Pick-up, GWM SOUO 및 GWM 브랜드 이름으로 SUV, 세단, 픽업 트럭, 다목적 차량(MPV), 오토바이, 대형 트럭 및 에너지 차량을 제공합니다. 또한 투자 및 금융, 물류 및 물품 운송, 건물 임대, 애프터 세일, 고객 판매, 기술 개발 및 컨설팅, 기술 및 금융 임대 서비스를 제공합니다. 자동차 연구 및 개발에 관한 컨설팅 서비스; 투자플랫폼을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 자동차를 수리합니다. 일반 물품 운송; 자동차 금형을 연구, 개발 및 제조합니다. 오토바이 및 관련 부품을 연구하고 제조합니다. 기술 서비스, 자동차 기술 연구 및 개발, 기술 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 폐기물 및 중고 자재를 가공, 재활용, 판매합니다. 또한, 자동차용품 도소매업도 영위하고 있습니다.
